30 inch Outswing Door Security Door Bars

text.description_html:
30 Inch Steel Exit Door Security Bars ESI-SB-01-0030

Heavy duty steel security bars for exit doors up to 30" wide.
*Measure the door width - NOT the door frame width.

These exit door security bars feature a unique, patented, hook-on / lift-off operation that is easy to use and emergency sensitive.

Easy to install! Each package includes a storage bracket, caution sign, and installation hardware.


For use on Metal, Wood or Fiberglass doors. The 1" x 27-3/4" 16 gauge square steel tubing fixed security DOOR BAR is thru-bolted to the door with the provided elevator bolts. The 1-1/4" x 32-3/4" 16 gauge square steel tubing LIFT-OFF security bar secures the door to the door frame when set in place. Prevents the doors removal even if the door hinges are cut by burglars!

ESI-SB-01-0030 Installation Instructions (PDF).

The heavy duty steel security bars are finished in gray powder coat epoxy baked to a semi-gloss. "L" bolts are 6-1/2" long with zinc chromate finish.

Optional 12-1/2" "L" bolts available for deep inset doors (Inset more than 5").

Exit Security bars are available in other sizes for outswing doors (Measure the door width - NOT the door frame width).

  • ESI-SB-01-0036 - Outswing Single Door 31" - 36" (Most Common)
  • ESI-SB-01-0042 - Outswing Single Door 37" - 42"
  • ESI-SB-01-0048 - Outswing Single Door 43" - 48"
  • ESI-SB-01-0060 - Outswing Double Door 60"
  • ESI-SB-01-3260 - Outswing Uneven 60" Double Doors
  • ESI-SB-01-0072 - Outswing Double Door 72"
  • ESI-SB-01-0084 - Outswing Double Door 84"
  • ESI-SB-01-0096 - Outswing Double Door 96"

    • Exit Security bars are available in another size for inswing doors (Measure the door width - NOT the door frame width).

  • ESI-SB-03-UV48 - Metal Frame Inswing Single Door up to 48"
  • ESI-SB-07-UV36 - Wood Frame Inswing Single Door up to 36"
  • ESI-SB-07-UV48 - Wood Frame Inswing Single Door up to 48"
  • ESI-SB-03-UV72 - Metal Frame Inswing Double Door up to 72"
  • ESI-SB-07-UV72 - Wood Frame Inswing Double Door up to 72"

    • You can cut the bars to length. Meaning, if you need the bar to be 28", you will cut down the 30" bar. There are TWO bars included. The LIFT-OFF BAR (Lift Up Bar - 32-3/4") for the inside of the doorjamb that locks the door in place, and DOOR BAR (27-3/4" length) that is thru-bolted to the door.

    *Measure the door width - NOT the door frame width. Fits outswing doors 26" to 30" wide.

    The LIFT-OFF BAR is up against / inside the door jamb, the DOOR BAR is thru-bolt fastened to the door. There is no way to get the door open or off from the outside once the LIFT-OFF BAR is put in place. Removing the door's hinge pins, hinges, or even the door knob will not matter. The door cannot be removed from the outside.
